stature.basis: Curly hair is attested ("the little curly headed corporal", Simmons 1896); colouring by heritage (an Ohio family of British descent), reconstructed. Height for age: the CDC 2000 stature-for-age table at the 5th centile for the age on 14 Aug 1812. Not a measurement. Why that centile: Steckel 1985 finds slave children below the first centile of modern standards and Komlos 2003 puts American apprentices of 14 at the 0.8th, while American adults reached about the 20th-30th; free children of a fed frontier household are set at the 5th, a soldier's or settler's family on rations.
